notes.title: The Shroomherder joins your ranks
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! :) 

Today’s patch adds a whole new character to Seer’s Gambit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/b53e28fb383b06bc82307282c518fbadf6799182.png[/img]

[h2]Meet the elegant Shroomherder and her minions. [/h2]
Command an army of shrooms all eager to do the bidding of their musty mistress. Build into poison or root and unleash nature’s sporific powers on your enemies! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/a9008d10cb06946be0132b3d77b28e8d3fe80834.gif[/img]

The Shroomherder will be available to everyone who owns Seer’s Gambit and will be available to recruit immediately without a need to unlock her. 

[b]Other changes, additions and bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] By popular demand, your Endless Run starting characters are now epic instead of rare. 
[*] Swiss Cheese of Protection now has 1%, 3% or 5% chance to grant invulnerability depending on rarity. 
[*] The Gravejester now has a  50% chance to gain 1 attack power when applying blind, when choosing this talent in the talent tree. 
[*] Increased Claudia’s tier 4 talent pick from 10 ability power to 25 ability power.
[*] Increased Gallants Attack Damage bonus to 10 on tier 2 and 15 on tier 5.
[*] Decreased Galants tier 3 skill tree pick from +12 armor to +10 on blind.
[*] Increased Finger’s tier 2 skill tree pick from 7 damage to 15 damage. 
[*] Increased Maxim’s tier 2 skill tree pick from 7 damage to 15 damage. 
[*] Updated a number of descriptions and translations to clarify skills and abilities.
[*] General bug fixes and stability improvements. 
[/list]

We are also releasing a DLC for Seer's Gambit adding the Candlemage and Good Knight to the mix. You can check out[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3654160/Seers_Gambit_Dawn_of_Unlikely_Heroes?snr=1_5_9_]Seer's Gambit: Dawn of Unlikely Heroes[/url] here. 

We hope you will enjoy these new heroes and updates. :)

-Sigrid & Mattias.

notes.title: Announcing: Seer's Gambit: Dawn of Unlikely Heroes
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that in June we’ll be releasing a DLC for Seer’s Gambit. Seer’s Gambit: Dawn of Unlikely Heroes which will add two new unique characters to the game. 

[h2][b]Candlemage[/b][/h2]
The manic Candlemage, wielding the power of fire and explosions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/1bf36a0600f9fb4623a05dab8b00f50fe0689114.gif[/img]
The candlemage spreads fire and mayhem with all his attacks and abilities and if specced for it his fire will persist for a while damaging enemies moving through them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/67dc56563970bab4d4fe3a6ba44a5db3aa639283.png[/img]

[h2][b]Good Knight[/b][/h2]
The stoic Good Knight taps into the mighty forces of Day and Night to slay foes and bolster allies. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/8f17810f1c51b4e48e2361fba2d3b179bb45bb54.gif[/img]
Toggling between Day and Night stance the Good Knight empowers and heals his allies while dishing out deadly damage to those that stand against him. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/97d4f752f2b3622be4e7053dc7b90ff011997b0d.png[/img]

To celebrate the release we’ll also add a brand new hero which will be completely free for everyone with the base game. 

Say hello to the elegant Shroomherder, a mysterious tactician who commands an army of shrooms all eager to do the bidding of their musty mistress. Build into poison or root and unleash nature’s sporific powers on your enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/a9008d10cb06946be0132b3d77b28e8d3fe80834.gif[/img]

We will share more info about the Shroomherder soon.

For now head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3654160/Seers_Gambit_Dawn_of_Unlikely_Heroes]Seer’s Gambit: Dawn of Unlikely Heroes page[/url] and wishlist it! :)

notes.title: Armed to the teeth: Secondary Equipment slot now live.
notes.content:
A secondary equipment slot has been one of the most requested features from our community since we launched in November and we're happy to announce that finally the feature is live! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/37cfe9969dd8cc3835c7f36a5252d35618374dd3.png[/img]

A Secondary item slot is now available for all heroes. This allows you to unlock new synergies, makes unlocking combos easier and increases the overall power level of your team. As such we’ve also re-balanced the majority of the game to ensure you still have interesting challenges. 

Seer's Gambit is massive and we're a small team of 2 people so there may be combinations of heroes and enemies where we've missed the mark with tuning. Should you come across such cases, please let us know and we'll take another look. 


[b]Additional changes, fixes and  adjustments:[/b]

Updated a number of skill descriptions to clarify what they are doing and how long they last. 

Fixed a bug where Claudia’s hot would get recast on every tick leading to pretty insane hot-numbers building over time. 

Fixed an issue where Burnard could become permanently invulnerable. 

Buffed Claudia's T4 skill tree pick from +10 to +25 ability power. 

Buffed Gallant's T5  skill tree pick from +7 to +15 attack power.

Adjusted the Gallant's T3 skill tree pick where you gain armor from damaging blinded enemies from 12 to 10.

Buffed Flora’s T5  skill tree pick from +7 to +15 attack power.

Buffed Maxim’s T4 skill tree pick from +7 to +15  attack power , the T5 skill tree pick from +7 to +25  attack power , the T5 skill tree pick from +10 to +25 ability power.

Adjusted the invulnerability chance on all rarities of Swiss Cheese of Protection and Glorious Shield to fix issues where characters could become permanently invulnerable. 

Added a health bonus to all rarities of  Swiss Cheese of Protection.

Adjusted the percentage chance for the Gravejester to gain attack power on blind from 100% to 50%

notes.title: Second Equipment Slot live on the beta branch & bug fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone. 

Today we’re excited to share the first version of the second equipment slot with you all. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/375b958f33603ecf0d8e2c417d671d4bc462b115.png[/img]

With the additional equipment slot it should be easier to activate combos and to get synergies rolling. It will have a significant impact on the difficulty of the game and as such we’ll be looking to balance around the new power level.

This is where your feedback is vital. Please let us know how the difficulty feels now both in Endless Mode and in the main game. 


[b]Join instructions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Right click Seer’s Gambit in your Steam Library
[*] Click Properties in the drop down menu
[*] Click Betas in the left hand menu
[*] Input the password: YouAreAmazing in the Private Betas field
[*] If it doesn’t automatically choose it, pick it in the Beta Participation drop down menu
[*] Your game should now update, if it doesn’t completely close down Steam and start it again.
[*] Profit! You should now be able to equip each character with 2 items. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes for live version:[/h2]

[list]
[*] End of day buffs in Endless Mode will now correctly show their rare and epic stats instead of only the common variation.
[*] Fixed an issue where Rosa the Red’s Wish Wisps wouldn’t explode. 
[*] Fixed an issue where it was hard to click the stats button in Endless Mode.
[*] Picking “end run” in the main game will no longer also end your Endless Run. 
[*] The Executioner bleed buff in Endless Mode now has an icon. 
[*] Increased the additional damage done to poisoned enemies for the Endless buff. 
[*] Minor graphical fix for shadows in Purple Dungeon tilesets. 
[/list]

As always we're looking forward to your feedback! :) 

Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Completely New Game Mode: Endless Run
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This is a big patch including a whole new way to challenge yourself in Seer's Gambit. Thank you to everyone who helped test and give feedback while this was on the beta branch, with your help we've been able to create something really fun. 

[h2]New mode available: Endless Run[/h2]
The Seer (and her heroes) have defeated the Cultist master, but the evil looming at the outskirts of reality is still attempting to push through the fabric separating our worlds. 
As you fight waves of increasingly difficult enemies, The Seer will grant you her boon at the end of each day. How long can you survive the onslaught? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/bd3454a7b671d3b99d4a55eebaf9386a46b2730a.png[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where heroes would die instantly after taking damage when on 1 HP, despite having armor that should block the damage. 
[*] Fixed a graphical error where characters and enemies would sometimes move behind the environment. 
[/list]


[h2]Background for the Endless Mode[/h2]

When we started development of Seer’s Gambit we first put together the combat loop and put it out for people to try. 


The game was simple. You would fight your way through a full day, then at the end get a choice between 3 buffs to your group. The goal was to get through as many days as you could before eventually getting destroyed by the ever more powerful foes. It was simple but people loved it. While a lot of you have told us how much you like exploring the overworld in Seer’s Gambit we’ve also gotten consistent requests to bring back Endless Mode. 
So here you are! 

What is Endless Mode? 
It’s designed to be a more challenging, bite-sized, roguelike version of the main game. No permanent meta-progression. Only your skills, choices and talent for luck will aid you in your quest to survive as many days as possible. 

Our next big patch will focus on adding the second item slot. We know a lot of you have been waiting for this and we hope to have something out on the beta branch for testing soon. 

Thank you again for all your support. We can’t wait to see you get way further in Endless Mode than we expect to be possible! 

Sigrid & Mattias. 

[previewyoutube=Z9fC1thKPOg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch notes January 8th 2025
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

The first patch notes of the New Year has a bunch of neat fixes for the live game and content for the upcoming Endless Mode on the beta branch.

[b]Live change log[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where buffs did not update correctly if the stats they were based on changed. Now all item buffs will correctly apply stats gains received after initially equipping the item granting the buff.
[*] Fixed an issue where bleed stats were not correctly applied to the character dealing the bleed damage.
[*]Added a cap to minions to prevent a number of issues caused by endless minion spawns.
[*]Updated the Simplified and Traditional Chinese translations for several achievements.
[*]Fixed an issue with the translation of credits for Simplified and Traditional Chinese. The font should now display properly.
[*]Fixed incorrect stats on the common Bleeding Dagger and buffed the bleed duration of the rare and epic version.
[*]When clicking old women they will now have their own unique sound and not the old man sound.
[*]Foxes now have a sound when clicked. What does the Fox say?
[/list]

[b]Endless Mode change log:[/b]

[list]
[*]Added 15 new end of day buffs.
[*]Rebalanced difficulty (this is an ongoing task so please keep feedback coming! :) )
[*]Fixed an issue with day buffs granting fire aura, where fire aura would not be properly applied.
[*]The day number now shows up in proper colour.
[/list]

It's been really cool seeing how far people can get in Endless Mode and we appreciate all the feedback we've gotten so far. Rest assure that we're still balancing the mode with the goal to have a fun new experience live for everyone this month.

We're so grateful to have you all take part of this journey with us! :)

Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Happy New Years Update!
notes.content:
Happy 2025 we hope you all had a fantastic entry into the new year! 🙂 

We're back from vacation. Kinda... In Sweden the 6th of January is a public holiday so we'll have the kids home for a long weekend. After that, though, we're back for real. 🙂

We spent yesterday and today diving back into work, and the development of a new patch for Endless mode is going well. We expect to push an update patch early to mid-next week. This patch will also include some fixes for the main game.

The next step is the long-awaited addition of a second item slot, which will require a balance pass for everything in the full game.

We hope to release this update before the end of the month, aiming to have it on the beta branch before the full release so that you can give feedback on how everything feels with the option to dual-wield.

Excited to get these updates out to you guys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/1b28b111b789798689fe118e2b129e288b05ff89.gif[/img]

notes.title: Patch notes December 19th
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

We have a new dual patch today updating both the live game and Endless mode on the beta branch. 

[b]Live changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Gloria would often choose to heal herself instead of the most damaged unit even when she was at full health. She will now correctly prioritize damaged heroes.
[*] The localization of Simplified Chinese has been updated and improved. 
[*] Fixed a graphical glitch where a blue line was showing at the top or bottom of certain areas.
[*] Fixed an issue where heroes would spawn on top of  walls or darkness on the Altar of Swords in the Purple Dungeon. 
[/list]
[b]Endless Mode changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] You can now get details on the end-of-day buffs you’ve selected by navigating to the details button in the character sheet. 
[*] Fixed an issue where world upgrade buffs would carry over to Endless Mode from the main game. 
[*] Added Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese localization for most of the new Endless Mode text. We are aware that a few are still missing and will address this in future updates. 
[/list]

You can find more information about how to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2219450/allnews/]access Endless Mode here.[/url]

This will likely be the last patch of the year as we’ll be traveling to visit family over Christmas & New Year. 

Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback,  you’ve given us so far, it has made all the hard work worth it.  

We wish you all happy holidays regardless if/how you celebrate and we can’t wait to get back to work in January to complete Endless Mode and implement the second item slot! :)

Sigrid & Mattias

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/fc3c53777761d368ba1759937810da46a9a01257.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes December 13th 2024
notes.content:
Happy Friday everyone, 

This pre-weekend patch brings some fixes to Burnard and events: 

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Burnard could become permanently invulnerable during boss fights. 
[*] Fixed a bug where Burnard’s skill tree heal only worked when he died from his ultimate ability. It now correctly heals the team when he dies from enemies as well. 
[*] Fixed a bug where events that deal damage to your team could crit.  
[/list]
In Endless Mode on the beta-branch we’ve fixed an issue where some end of day buffs didn’t work. We’re still tuning the difficulty and as a result of this fix, the mode may feel too easy after day 2. 

In general we’re very interested in feedback on the difficulty of Endless Mode. If you play, please let us know your thoughts! 

Thank you for another great week. 

Mattias & Sigrid

notes.title: Endless Mode Playtest now available
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

We're now ready to share the first version of our new game mode: Endless Mode. 

It's a bite-sized version of the main game where you challenge yourself to survive as many days as possible and climb your own personal high-score. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/03368c80bde571860501394541f8ddcb8aeed7d5.png[/img]

We still have some balancing and polishing to do, however we believe that sharing early will enable us to create a much better experience.  

[b]Here are a couple of things that’s already planned and will be added soon: [/b]
[list]
[*] Buff overview (A way to see all Endless Buffs you've picked)
[*] Translations (English only for now, but we’re working on translations)
[*] Balance is still being tweaked. Let us know if something feels off. 
[*] Achievements for reaching day X, Y and Z
[*] General ooomphh and feel polish. 
[/list]

We're specifically looking for input on: 

[list]
[*] Difficulty (Are there areas, days or enemies that are too hard)?
[*] Anything that doesn’t work as expected?
[*] How far do you manage to get? (And if you can include the group)
[/list]

We’re excited to hear your thoughts on the new mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/3671ed40db5ac1faf722b2e91ec767b3d106a70c.png[/img]

[b]Join instructions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Right click Seer’s Gambit in your Steam Library
[*] Click Properties in the dropdown menu
[*] Click Betas in the left hand menu
[*] Input the password: [u][i]YouAreAmazing[/i][/u] in the Private Betas field
[*] If it doesn’t automatically choose it, pick it in the Beta Participation drop down menu
[*] Your game should now update, if it doesn’t completely close down Steam and start it again.
[*] Profit! You should now see the Endless Mode option in the main menu of Seer’s Gambit.
[/list]

Thank you again for your input, it helps us create a better game for everyone! :) 

Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Seer's Gambit Roadmap update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

It's been a bit more than 2 weeks since we launched Seer's Gambit and it’s been amazing to see so many players discovering and enjoying our game.

Since launch, we’ve been hard at work addressing feedback, fixing urgent bugs, resolving balancing issues, and adding quality-of-life features. 

While there are still some bugs to tackle, we’re now at a point where we can begin focusing on adding new features—starting with two that have been highly requested by the community.

Here's a roadmap outlining what you can expect for the next period of time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/479343734837699bd10cb5ec21ddb06abc6af36e.png[/img]

In the background we're also working on improving the controller support, with the aim to have full controller support in the end. 

These new features will be available on a beta branch first so you guys have the option to provide feedback before they are fully released. 

We're incredibly grateful to have such an awesome community supporting us and we're looking forward to adding these oft requested features so you can continue enjoying Seer's Gambit. 

Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Patch Notes December 4th
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

We have a couple of impactful bug-fixes for Burnard and Gravejester fans today. 

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Burnard could sometimes die when casting his Immolation ultimate despite timing it to trigger his resurrection. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Gravejesters grave attacks scaled by much higher numbers than intended, resulting in one-shotting bosses. We will keep an eye on the Gravejesters performance to make sure they are still a viable hero after this fix.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could grab and sell the XP potion from recruit events.
[/list]

We’re currently working on a new game mode. We will share more shortly, but the plan is to have it up on a beta-branch soon so you can test it out for yourself and provide us feedback. 

We’re also working on implementing a second item slot. The hope is to have both features out in beta before Christmas, but we want to make sure they are ready so we appreciate your patience while we test and add polish. :) 

More info to come!

Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Patch December 2nd
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

Happy December! :)

We started out the new month with everyone in the household catching a cold. We're slowly recovering though and we've manged to put together a small patch with some bug-fixes for you. 

[list]
[*] Charged Subject now has crit on all rarities
[*] Bleeding Dagger now scales properly on all rarities
[*] Fixed an issue where some players did not receive the achievement for tipping 10 cows, even though they had the subsequent ones.  
[*] Fixed a graphical glitch where a door could get hidden when clicked.

Also added a new bopping second song to beach areas. Enjoy! 

We're still chasing down a number of larger bugs and will continue to patch the game as we solve them. We're also working on something new and exciting for the game which we can hopefully share soon. 

Sigrid and Mattias.

notes.title: Patch Notes November 29th
notes.content:
Happy Friday everyone! Hope you’re all doing awesome. 🙂

Today’s patch includes a couple of bug fixes that should make regen items much more impactful: 

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Armor and Health regen would apply flat numbers instead of percentage-based values. 
[*] Fixed an issue where you could get stuck with a level up button instead of a continue button  if you exited the game to the main menu while having the level up button active.

We’re working on a new feature and hope to be able to share it on a beta-branch with you all next week. Until then, have a fantastic weekend!

notes.title: Patch Notes November 28th: Blind fix, load time improvement and more
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Today’s patch brings more bug fixes and stability improvements.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where blind was not cleared properly resulting in characters being blind for an entire day. 
[*] Loading time should be slightly improved. We’re still looking into how we can decrease this further, but getting into the game should now be a bit faster. 
[*] Fixed a bug where your Glod didn’t update properly if you sold an item at the merchant, meaning you were still unable to purchase an item even though you technically could afford it after selling items. 
[*]The Cultist now properly empowers in all phases. This should fix issues where you got stuck in endless healing loops during the boss fight. 
[*] Heavy Anvil’s attack speed penalty has been decreased from 1.5s to 0.5s
[*] Fixed  smaller graphical glitches in multiple areas.
[/list]
Thank you to everyone who has shared logs, reported bugs and helped us detect issues. Because of your support we’re able to make Seer’s Gambit better every day! 🙂

-Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Patch Notes November 27th: Cloud Save and bug fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone. 

Today we're adding something that has been massively requested by the community, the ability to use Steams Cloud Save feature. We also address some of the most reported bugs. 

Here's what you get with this patch: 

[list]
[*] Steam Cloud Save is now available. 
[/list]
Please make sure that the cloud save is synchronized correctly before your first game on a new machine. If the continue button is greyed out, the save hasn’t synced yet. If that happens, please restart the game and wait for the sync. 
[b]Be aware that pressing the “New Game” button will start a completely new game including clearing your meta progression [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Fernandez combo Inspiring Slam also applied to himself, resulting in cases where a group could become permanently invulnerable. 
[*] Fixed a bug where Kao wasn't always applying status effects correctly. 
[*] Fixed a bug where Clavel wasn't always applying status effects correctly. 
[*] Fixed a bug where Gravejester wasn't always applying status effects correctly. 
[*] Fixed a bug where Lars wasn't always applying status effects correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where invulnerability could stack infinitely. Invulnerability now caps at 5s as intended. 
[/list]

In the background we're working on both improvements and something new for the game. Thank you for your ongoing support. Stay tuned for more! :) 

Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Patch Notes November 25th: Bug fixes, speed option and improved translations
notes.content:
It's Monday and we're working full speed on addressing bug reports and improving the game. 

We're also starting work on some additions to the game, a roadmap will be shared soon. :) 

[h3]Here are today's fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added the option to run the game at 3x speed. You can now run the game in 0.5, 1, 2, 3 and 4 times the speed
[*] Improved the Chinese translation in a number of places to make character skills and abilities clearer. 
Please keep reporting translation issues, we’re continuously working on improving them.
[*] Fixed a bug where Fernandez additional Health on stun wasn't applied correctly. 
[*] Fixed a bug where after defeating the last boss the game could crash landing you on a black screen. 
[*] Fixed a bug where you could increase thorns cast by Blossoms by clicking character portraits.
[*] Fixed a bug where items and XP potions could be duplicated by exiting and re-entering the game.
[*] Fixed a graphical bug with a flying gemstone on the worldmap.
[/list]

[h3]Character changes: [/h3]

[list]
[*] Gallant: Ultimate power gain via ultimate kills has been decreased from 3 to 1
[*] Gravejester: Attack gain via attacking blinded people has been decreased from 3 to 1
[*] Fernandez: Health on stun has been changed to 100% chance to gain 1 health permanently.
[/list]

notes.title: November 24 Patch notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Happy Sunday! :)

A small patch today since the kids are home from school and kindergarten:

You will now not be able to click the confirm button for going to the End Boss before the node capture is properly registered. This to prevent cases where you don't get properly credited for visiting a node. 

Fixed an issue where using Alt+Enter to fullscreen your game would break the UI, hiding important elements like the bag or the hourglass. To set the game to fullscreen, use the toggle in options. Please let us know if you still run into resolution issues. 

That's it. Tomorrow we will be back in full swing, fixing bugs and working on some new cool stuff for Seer's Gambit. As always, thank you for your support and ongoing patience. We really appreciate it! :)

Sigrid & Mattias.

notes.title: Patch Notes November 23rd: New Game Button change and bug fixes.
notes.content:
Hi everyone. A weekend patch incoming! :) 

[list]
[*] Moved the New Game button into options if you have an already active run. The new game button now also has an extra warning to make it clearer that all progress will be reset. We will continue looking into better ways to implement this, but hopefully this fix will help prevent further unintentional game progress resets. 
[/list]
[b]NOTE:[/b] If you unintentionally reset your progress by choosing a “New Game”, we can help you by recreating a save file with the progress you had. You can reach out to us either on Discord or on unleashthegiraffe@gmail.com and we’ll do our best to help you. 


[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where getting offered a Barber Ian in recruit events could reset your teams skill tree buffs. 
Please let us know if your skill tree buffs still gets reset after this patch as there may be multiple causes for this bug. 

[*] Fixed an error where one of Gallants skill tree buff was listed as ability power increase rather than ultimate power increase. 
[/list]

notes.title: Always Auto Toggle, End Run Button and Bug fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone and happy Friday. 

Today's patch is both a bunch of bug fixes and some quality of life features that have been requested by a lot of you. 

[h2]New features: [/h2]

[b]Always Auto Toggle[/b]
You can now toggle whether you want heroes to always have auto-cast on. This toggle can be found in the general tab. To make space we’ve moved equipment into its own tab. 

[b]End Run Button[/b]
A new button to end your current run has been added. You can access this button when in the combat part of the game by pressing escape. 

[h2]Bug fixes: [/h2]

[b]Barber Ian[/b]
Fixed an issue where fights could go on forever when you had a Barber Ian in your group.
Barber Ian will no longer become invulnerable while using his ultimate ability. 
Barber Ians health has been increased by 50(common), 100(rare), and 150(epic).


[b]Fernandez[/b]
Fixed a bug where Fernandez skill tree node that adds permanent health on stun wasn’t working and increased the health gain from +2 to +3
   
[b]Lars the Lasher[/b]
The extra damage from Lars Lashers’ skill tree node that adds attack for each ally with heal over time is now applied properly. 

The Super Ouch! achievement now triggers correctly when you do 500+ damage. 

On top of this we've fixed a number of minor bugs and balancing issues. 

We are aware that there are still some pretty severe bugs that needs attention and are working hard on tracking their causes down.  

We’re currently specifically looking into:
[list]
[*] Buffs that reset
[*] Fights where you get stuck in a loop of not being able to die or kill the enemies 
[*] Not receiving credit when discovering a node on the final day. 
[/list]
But of course we're also collecting feedback on other bugs and issues and will do our best to get to those as quickly as possible. 

Thank you again for your support and patience as we chip away at bugs and add more  QoL to Seer’s Gambit it means a ton for a tiny team like ours. 

Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Stability and Bug-fix patch November 21st
notes.content:
Hi everyone! :)

With this patch we’ve added a number of fixes that should decrease how often characters get stuck and stop attacking in combat. 
This is not one single bug, but a number of issues that can cause it. We’ll continue to patch this when we track down more causes. Please continue to report this to us when you experience this issue. Thank you! :) 


[list]
[*]All characters should now be much less likely to get stuck doing nothing in combat. 
[*] The world map upgrade making the first reroll of the day free was not working. This has been fixed.
[*] Gallant self-heal talent tree now works! Upon testing it, we realized it was massively overpowered, so its has been nerfed from 50% of ability power to 25% of ability power.
[*] Thorns could scale out of control. This has now been addressed. Thorns are still awesome! 
[*] The Cultist now does more damage in Phase 1
[*] The minions spawned by the Cultist in Phase 1 are now slightly weaker
[*] The Cultist now powers up over time in Phase 1
[*] The rain cast by the Cultist in Phase 4 now does more damage. 
[*] Fixed a rare issue where you would spawn into the Tutorial instead of the main game when starting pressing continue game. 
[/list]

We’re continuing working through the bug reports and feedback you send to us. Thank you for your support and patience! 

Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Balance Patch for Day 6&7
notes.content:
Hi everyone. 

As promised a patch to tweak the difficulty of day 6&7, you should now no longer feel like the difficulty spikes artificially between day 5&6. 

Also just want to let you know we're actively working on fixing bugs where characters get stuck and stop attacking. We have some fixes in progress, we just need to test them properly before we can release them. 

Thanks again for your ongoing patience while we tweak the game experience to where we want it to be. :)

Please keep providing feedback, it helps us make the game better. 

Sigrid & Mattias.

notes.title: Balancing Patch
notes.content:
We've been listening to your feedback on the balancing and made some pretty sweeping changes that we hope will make the game more fun. We are not done with tweaking yet. So stay tuned for more updates. 

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Decreased difficulty of  all starting areas surrounding taverns. 
[*] Decreased the difficulty of all areas from Chapter 2 onward. You’ll still need to pick some world upgrades, but you should now be able to survive longer.
[*] Prices for upgrades have been lowered, making it easier to get upgrades. 
[*] Added an extra warning when selecting "New Game" to clarify that this will reset all your progress.
[/list]

[b]We are working to fix the following bugs and will release a patch as soon as they are resolved:[/b]

[list]
[*] Some heroes can get stuck while fighting. 
[*] Your team can get stuck when fighting the final boss.
[*] Snowball buffs occasionally reset unexpectedly.
[/list]
Finding and resolving these bugs are our top priority, alongside ensuring the game’s difficulty feels right for everyone.

[b]Here’s what we hope to add in the near future:[/b]
[list]
[*]Address the big jump in difficulty after day 5. This is deeply tied to the core gameloop of upgrading the world, but we understand that the current implementation feels too punishing so we want to look into how we can make this more fun. 
[*] An option to toggle whether heroes automatically have auto-cast turned on when recruited.
[*] An additional recruitment opportunity on the first day to help build your team faster.
[*] An extra equipment slot for all heroes.
[*] A "Hard Mode" where you can play the game at its original difficulty.
[/list]

We also have bigger plans for version 1.1, which we’ll share with you soon.

We really want this game to shine in all areas and we are working hard to make that happen. In the meantime, we ask for your patience and understanding. We’re a small team but we’re working hard to fix everything. 

Please join us on our discord, and continue to provide feedback—it’s invaluable in helping us make the game better for everyone.

notes.title: Launch Day + 1 Status - Bug fixing and Balance passes
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

We’re a little more than a day past launch and the support and feedback has been fantastic and overwhelming. Thank you! 

With that said we’re not happy with some of the issues players have encountered so far and we’re working hard on addressing all the reports and feedback we’ve received. 

Here’s a non-exhaustive list of what we’re focusing on right now:

[h2]Fixing stuck bugs. [/h2]

We’ve received reports from players that heroes can stop attacking and get stuck in combat. This is a high priority bug for us to fix since it can end an otherwise great run. If you have this bug please help us by doing the following:

1) Close down the game (You will not lose all progress. Only fights you’ve done on that ingame day will be lost)
2) Navigate to this folder C:\Users\[YOURNAME]\AppData\LocalLow\Unleash the Giraffe
3) Zip the folder called “SeersGambit”
4) Send it as well as a description of the bug you’ve encountered to us at unleashthegiraffe+bug@gmail.com include [Bug Report] in the subject Subject Line or contact us on our Discord https://discord.gg/zk3pQWmESm

[h2]Tweaking balance[/h2]

We’ve already pushed a couple of balancing passes, but we’re not done. We’re looking at individual nodes, enemy composition and general balance at the moment. If there are specific nodes you’re struggling with, please let us know and we’ll take a closer look at those. 

We’ll also soon release a patch that reduces the cost of upgrades to make progress feel less grindy. 

[h2]Fixing other high impact bugs[/h2]

We’re tracking all reports and have a list of high impact bugs we want to address. Please do keep reporting issues you run into so we can add them to our list

[h2]Prepping for 1.1[/h2]

We have a bunch of ideas for 1.1, this week we’re listening to the community, collecting feedback on what you’d like to improve, change or add. Based on this we’ll be able to create a better 1.1 for everyone. Next week we’ll give you more info on what 1.1 will include. 

We’re not happy that we’ve had players run into run-ending bugs, but we’re committed to fixing these issues so you can enjoy the game. We ask you for patience while we fix this, we’re a tiny team of two, but we’re working hard on getting everything solved. 

Thank you again for your massive support so far. We’re very, very grateful!

notes.title: Major Demo Update: New areas, weapons and enemies
notes.content:
As we get closer to release, more and more work is going into pure content addition, polishing, and balancing. It's been so much fun to populate Emalon and build out the journey that the Seer plans for her unfortunate but very brave volunteering heroes. 

With this demo update, you'll have your first encounter with the true evil threatening Emalon. What is this purple goo and why has it awoken the dead from their silent slumber? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/cba82968ea57b6d2c76e95d66eebbbad8c3543ec.png[/img]

[h2][b]Changelog[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Added 2 new area types: The deep Forests of Emalon and the Corrupted Dungeons.

[*] Added 3 new nodes to explore including "The Maw" a dangerous Zombie infested dungeon claimed by the purple corruption.

[*] Added 6 new Zombie-type enemies to defeat.

[*] Buffed and reworked the majority of items to make it feel more impactful when equipping something. 
 
[*] Added a bunch of new items to make a number of specs more viable. Including more poison items. 

[*] Updated hero portraits to make it more clear which bars refer to attack and ability timers and which are indicators of health and armor. 

[*] Tweaked and balanced hero skill trees to ensure that all heroes have multiple viable builds. 

[*] Changed the tags on a number of heroes to balance tag numbers and to make it easier to unlock combos.

[*] Added upgrade indicators to nodes. On explored nodes you can now see the number of unlocked or locked upgrades directly on the world map without having to open the node.

[*] Fixed an issue where items wouldn't sell after they were unequipped.

[*] Fixed an issue where the game could crash in the tutorial if you scrolled and clicked a node too quickly. 

[*] Fixed a number of graphical glitches where heroes would walk under terrain or items. 

[*] Fixed a bunch of bugs and stability issues.

[*] Added more music and sounds. 
[/list]

Thank you again for all your support so far. If you enjoy the game, please share it with your friends to help us get the word out! :) 

Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: New events, Korean and Japanese language option and lots and lots of bug fixes
notes.content:
August is almost over and we've been working hard on a ton of new content for release. Soon we may be able to give you a sneak peek of the final boss... 

But we've also spent time reviewing and fixing feedback from you all. Thank you to everyone who has taken the time to share your thoughts either here or on Discord. 

Finally, we've added Korean and Japanese language options taking the number of languages Seer's Gambit can be played in to a total of 5. 

Here is a high level overview of all changes, fixes and additions. 

[b]Change log Demo version 0.19[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a number of new events and updated/Balanced old ones
[*] Clarified many skill descriptions
[*] Rebalanced difficulty for day 1-4
[*] Korean language option added
[*] Japanese language option added
[*] Improved Traditional and Simplified Chinese translations
[*] Fixed a number of bugs that could cause characters to get stuck or stop attacking

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/77c619b6274d68658d8bf33adf6cbf6dee21c11e.png[/img]

notes.title: Seer's Gambit Dev Update July
notes.content:
We've almost reached the content phase of development for Seer's Gambit. This means that most big features and systems are implemented and now we can focus on adding cool content to the game. 

I say almost, because we still have one big ticket left to sort. Controller support. We want to make sure that Seer's Gambit can be played and enjoyed equally whether you prefer keyboard & mouse or controllers. There's a lot of work involved to ensure that the game feels native to both ways of navigating, but the most challenging thing has been to ensure that it also works well on a smaller screen. Because we want to make sure it can be played on the Steam Deck! :) 

For the past week we've worked on adjusting and polishing UI and menus to ensure that text and icons are legible on smaller screens while still looking good on PC. We're almost there and then it's full throttle on content. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/69e308c031ca4bc336e27596ca06733666dad7d9.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Zone and Enemies[/h2]

But controller support isn't all we've been working on. We've implemented a whole new zone-type to explore. The purple dungeon where corruption has seeped in and turned all previous inhabitants into feral zombies and mutants. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/6cb8ec1b4101d2f3ee71f4b6ccf7aabdbff732a3.png[/img]

Along with a new zone-type comes a bunch of new enemies to challenge your merry band of adventurers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/9734058ab2f4c689f7c89642721fdfc87352712f.gif[/img]


[h2]New Characters[/h2]

We've also had time to add 3 new characters to the game. 

[b]The Gravejester[/b] swaps place with the most damaged friendly unit and puts down graves to block the enemy advance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/6755d65736cafe95e496a9effc29bce76f9fb546.gif[/img]

[b]Lars the Lasher[/b] uses his fearsome whip to yoink friends out of harms way. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/300abc70dbafaedf86b6b37faa8bba159edc04da.gif[/img]

[b]Clavel[/b] who feeds on her enemies (and friends) to keep alive. She's an excellent tank as long as your other heroes doesn't get too close to her. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/7cd16525b1dfb67552477945eb01a85b958a5ab2.gif[/img]

We have a lot more in the works and will share more updates soon. Stay tuned! :) 

-Mattias & Sigrid

notes.title: The "What's my name again?" patch
notes.content:
We've received a ton of great feedback on the demo the last couple of weeks. Thank you so much! 

Some of it we'll carry with us as we develop the game further over the next months. But some of it we could add fairly quickly so we decided to throw together another demo patch and get it out to you guys: 

You are now able to rename your heroes.
While we are very proud of the hero names we've come up with, we do understand that you want to name Fernandez after your great aunt Irma and that Blossom might work better as EvilPoisonLady. 

To rename a hero, just open their character sheet and click the small pen icon next to their current name. Then get creative. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/e757c7b019f1a83961d689e693ec987399d63587.gif[/img]

You can now zoom in during combat. 
Ever wanted to take an extra look at the pain you bring to your enemies? Now you can use your scroll wheel to zoom in during combat and inspect the pixel carnage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/0400cce556641e9563a876991239bc18097c15a9.gif[/img]

A number of bug-fixes and stability issues have been solved. 

Fixed a spelling error where Glod was miss-spelled gold in one of Fingers combos. 


As always, keep the feedback coming, we really appreciate it! :)

Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Skill Tree Update, event rework and detailed character view
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Once again we've received a lot of excellent feedback and based on that we've implemented a number of improvements and updates to the demo. 

We were told by several players that they didn't feel they could really snowball with any of the builds. We knew this could be a bit challenging with some of the restrictions we put in with the demo. To be very honest a bunch of things was just not ready to release when we first launched the demo. 

Now however we've implemented all skill trees for the available heroes. As you will notice there are a lot of ways to build power and potentially snowball over the course of run. Hopefully you'll have as much fun with that as we've had while testing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/e8ab81af0e8efc1c49693696a4934fea9b571894.png[/img]

[b]Here are the full patch notes:[/b]


[h2]New Features and Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Character skill trees have been updated. All nodes are now available and functional in the demo. 
[*] New Item - Rootgrower. On attack, chance to root enemy. Increases character range.
[*] Automode is now unique for each character now your Barber Ian clone doesn't have to auto just because the original does.
[*] Events have been reworked. 
[*] Status Effect Icons and Improved Tooltips has been added. 
[*] Detailed view for each character with TONS of information. Now you stats nerds can really min/max! :)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a number of bugs that caused heroes to stop attacking and just idle. 
[*] Fixed a number of bugs and issues in the Tutorial. 
[*] Improved readability of abilities and skill trees
[*] Sound fixes and updates
[*] Fixed a number of performance and load issues.
[*] Fixed a number of bugs that caused heroes to stop attacking and just idle. 
[*] Fixed a couple of issues caused by restarting the game. 
[*] A number of other bug fixes and quality of life updates. 
[/list]

Please continue to provide us with feedback either here or on our [url=https://discord.gg/EyWgvSthpM]Discord [/url]

We're especially curious to hear what you think about the new skill trees and how we can improve on the details view. We know it's a bit rough at the moment. 

Thank you for all your support. 

Sigrid & Mattias

notes.title: Auto-ulti cast, faster loadspeed and day tracker
notes.content:
Based on all the great feedback we've received since setting the demo live last week we're now ready with our first Steam demo patch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44519271/1e0857ec98043768c19b3f67ce72102c0fabd712.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Added the option to have heroe's cast their ultimate automatically. This can be toggled on the character sheet for each hero. If toogled on, heroes will use their ultimate immediately when it becomes available. 

[*] The game should now load faster. We've done a bunch of work to optimize the initial loadspeed.

[*] A Day tracker has been added. You will now know how many days you've survived. Happy Chooseday! 

[*] The hourglass and lootbag has been moved the left of the screen so it no longer gets hidden by the begin battle button. 

[*] Fixed an issue where you could go into minus with your gold. 

[*] We've rebalanced a bunch of hero ultimates, skills and attacks to ensure that they can all shine. 

[*] A number of minor bugs and graphical glitches has been addressed. 
[/list]

Please keep letting us know if you encounter issues in the game and if you're having fun, let us (and your friends) know as well. 

Thank you for your ongoing support! :)

Sigrid & Mattias - Unleash the Giraffe

notes.title: Seer's Gambit Demo live NOW!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that the demo for Seer's Gambit is now live here on Steam. 

In November we uploaded our first demo to itch.io and it has since received over 13k play-sessions there. 

Based on the fantastic feedback we've received from those testing the early demo we've polished, improved and added to the demo. 

[b]What's New:[/b]

[list]
[*]     Draft 13 Unique Heroes: Explore powerful synergies by unlocking character combos.
[*]     Equip a Variety of Items: Customize your heroes with a wide range of equipment.

The demo is ready for you to dive in and give it a spin and we can't wait to hear your feedback. 

Tell us what you enjoy, what you don't like and what's confusing. We'll use that input to improve Seer's Gambit even further ahead of release. 

Also if you like the demo, please wishlist it and share it with your friends. It will help us immensely! 

Thank you for your ongoing support.
